engXBook: Who is the person who writes the story in a book?
The author is the person who writes the words of a book.
Who makes the drawings that go with the story?
The illustrator creates the pictures in a book.
Which part of a book holds the pages together and shows on a bookshelf?
The spine is the edge of a book you see when it stands on a shelf.
Where is the title of a book usually found?
The title is printed on the front cover so readers can find the book.
What do we call the paper sheets inside a book that we read?
The words and pictures of a book are printed on its pages.
When you finish reading a book, which part do you close?
The back cover is at the end of the book, so you close it when you finish.
Mia reads the words by Robert Munsch on the cover. Who is Robert Munsch?
The word by before a name tells us who wrote the book.
A book cover says Pictures by Michael Martchenko. Who is Michael Martchenko?
Pictures by tells us who drew the illustrations.
What tells you what a book is called?
The title is the name of the book.
Which way do you turn the pages in an English book?
From right to left, front to back
From the back to the front
English books are read from front to back, turning each page from right to left.
Where do you begin reading the words on a page?
In English we start reading at the top left of the page.
Which way do your eyes move when you read a line of English words?
English words are read from left to right across the line.
